crossRefs.note: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ; To all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers…
to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call…
Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ…
Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.
and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:
But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received…
Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.
translations.bsb: Greet all the saints in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send you greetings.
translations.kjv: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.
translations.asv: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren that are with me salute you.
